question: Which of the following was the venue of the first ICC Test Championship final between India and New Zealand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The final of the 2019–2021 ICC World Test Championship**, the inaugural ICC World Test Championship, was played from **18 to 23 June 2021** at the Rose Bowl, Southampton, **England, between India and New Zealand.**
 
• **The inaugural ICC WTC 2019-21 cycle **final was also **scheduled to be played at the Lord's Cricket Ground but due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the final was shifted.**
 
• It was played at the **Ageas Bowl in Southampton**, where Kane Williamson-led New Zealand defeated Virat Kohli-led India to become the first-ever World Test.
 
• **India dropped to the 4th spot on the World Test Championship table** after they were penalized for slow over-rate in the rescheduled 5th Test against England in Birmingham.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**South Africa has consolidated the second spot in the ICC World Test Championship points table.**
 
• **New Zealand won the match by eight wickets to be crowned as the winners of the inaugural ICC World Test Championship.**
